visual.name: PowerBIChatbot
visual.description: AI chatbot for Power BI: ask your data questions in plain language and get answers you can check, charts and DAX formulas. Uses an external AI service: SmartVisuals AI is included with a free licence key (no API key needed), or bring your own key for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, xAI or Azure OpenAI. Free on-device Instant Insights work without a licence. Interface in English, Czech, German, Spanish and French.
